name: Indonesia
change_summary: The corrected base under PP 6/2025: JHT 2%/3.7%; JP 1%/2% with the 10,547,400 ceiling; JKK I–V 0.10–1.60% and JKM 0.30%; JKP 0.14% employer; Kesehatan 1%/4% with the Perpres 59/2024 art.32(2) minimum-wage floor; PPh 21 TER; PP 35/2021 working time and the statutory leave heads.

work_rules.authority: Peraturan Pemerintah No. 35 Tahun 2021 Pasal 27(1) — an employer who employs a worker beyond the Pasal 21(2) working hours must pay overtime wages; the regulation sets no wage threshold, and its only exception (Pasal 27(2)) is by job group, which this workspace cannot yet express. Pasal 26(1) caps overtime at 4 hours in a day and 18 hours in a week, and Pasal 26(2) puts overtime worked on a weekly rest day or an official public holiday outside that cap. Undang-Undang No. 13 Tahun 2003 Pasal 79(2)(a) as amended by Undang-Undang No. 6 Tahun 2023 gives a break of at least 30 minutes after 4 continuous hours, not counted as working time, and Pasal 79(2)(b) one rest day for every 6 working days in a week. Applied 2026-09-18: PP 35/2021 art.32(1)–(4): the overtime hour is 1/173 of the monthly wage, basic plus the fixed allowances (`terms.monthly_wage`); art.21: the normal day is seven hours on a six-day week, eight on a five-day one (`normal_hours`); art.26(2): rest-day and holiday overtime are outside the four-hour and eighteen-hour ceilings, which the monthly counter already leaves out.

name: Indonesia — 2026-01-01
change_summary: The 2026 UMP under PP 49/2025 (DKI Jakarta 5,729,876; Jawa Barat 2,317,601; Kabupaten Bekasi 5,938,885) lifts the BPJS Kesehatan floor on 1 January 2026. Nothing else moves.

name: Indonesia — 2026-03-01
